WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_stage AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill_size, avg_fill_size - (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM order_averages) AS margin_first
  FROM order_averages
  WHERE avg_fill_size > (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM order_averages)
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_fill_size FROM first_stage
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT f.ordersmark, f.avg_fill_size, f.margin_first,
         f.avg_fill_size - b.avg_fill_size AS margin_second
  FROM first_stage AS f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b
  WHERE f.avg_fill_size > b.avg_fill_size
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin_first) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(margin_second) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders;
